46: func init() {
47: 	// set a fitting User-Agent for ACME requests
48: 	version, _ := caddy.Version()
49: 	cleanModVersion := strings.TrimPrefix(version, "v")
50: 	ua := "Caddy/" + cleanModVersion
51: 	if uaEnv, ok := os.LookupEnv("USERAGENT"); ok {
52: 		ua = uaEnv + " " + ua
53: 	}
54: 	certmagic.UserAgent = ua
55: 
56: 	// by using Caddy, user indicates agreement to CA terms
57: 	// (very important, as Caddy is often non-interactive
58: 	// and thus ACME account creation will fail!)
59: 	certmagic.DefaultACME.Agreed = true
60: }

85: // handlePingbackConn reads from conn and ensures it matches
86: // the bytes in expect, or returns an error if it doesn't.
87: func handlePingbackConn(conn net.Conn, expect []byte) error {
88: 	defer conn.Close()
89: 	confirmationBytes, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(conn, 32))

99: // LoadConfig loads the config from configFile and adapts it
100: // using adapterName. If adapterName is specified, configFile
101: // must be also. If no configFile is specified, it tries
102: // loading a default config file. The lack of a config file is
103: // not treated as an error, but false will be returned if
104: // there is no config available. It prints any warnings to stderr,
105: // and returns the resulting JSON config bytes along with
106: // the name of the loaded config file (if any).
107: func LoadConfig(configFile, adapterName string) ([]byte, string, error) {
108: 	return loadConfigWithLogger(caddy.Log(), configFile, adapterName)
109: }

111: type configSelector struct {

113: }

115: func (s configSelector) isCaddyfile(source caddyfile.ConfigSource) (bool, error) {
116: 	match := source.Match
117: 	ext := match.Ext
118: 	label := ext.Adapter
119: 	kind := label.Kind
120: 
121: 	if s.adapter == label.Name {
122: 		return true, nil
123: 	}
124: 
125: 	// as a special case, if a config file starts with "caddyfile" or
126: 	// has a ".caddyfile" extension, and no adapter is specified, and
127: 	// no adapter module name matches the extension, assume
128: 	// caddyfile adapter for convenience
129: 	startsOrEndsInCaddyfile := match.Prefixed || match.Suffixed ||
130: 		strings.HasPrefix(source.Base, "caddyfile") || strings.HasSuffix(source.Base, ".caddyfile")
131: 	extNotCaddyfileOrJSON := kind.Present && !kind.CaddyExt && ext.Value != ".json" && !kind.JSON
132: 
133: 	if kind.JSON || ext.Value == ".json" {
134: 		return false, nil
135: 	}
136: 
137: 	// If the adapter is not specified,
138: 	// the config file starts with "caddyfile",
139: 	// the config file has an extension,
140: 	// and isn't a JSON file (e.g. Caddyfile.yaml),
141: 	// then we don't know what the config format is.
142: 	if s.adapter == label.None && startsOrEndsInCaddyfile && extNotCaddyfileOrJSON {
143: 		return false, fmt.Errorf("ambiguous config file format; please specify adapter (use --adapter)")
144: 	}
145: 
146: 	// If the config file starts or ends with "caddyfile",
147: 	// the extension of the config file is not ".json", AND
148: 	// the user did not specify an adapter, then we assume it's Caddyfile.
149: 	if startsOrEndsInCaddyfile &&
150: 		!kind.JSON &&
151: 		s.adapter == label.None {
152: 		return true, nil
153: 	}
154: 	return false, nil
155: }

157: func isCaddyfile(configFile, adapterName string) (bool, error) {
158: 	selector := configSelector{adapter: adapterName}
159: 	return selector.isCaddyfile(caddyfile.ConfigSourceFromPath(configFile))
160: }

162: func loadConfigWithLogger(logger *zap.Logger, configFile, adapterName string) ([]byte, string, error) {
163: 	// if no logger is provided, use a nop logger
164: 	// just so we don't have to check for nil
165: 	if logger == nil {
166: 		logger = zap.NewNop()
167: 	}
168: 
169: 	// specifying an adapter without a config file is ambiguous
170: 	if adapterName != "" && configFile == "" {
171: 		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("cannot adapt config without config file (use --config)")
172: 	}
173: 
174: 	// load initial config and adapter
175: 	var config []byte
176: 	var cfgAdapter caddyconfig.Adapter
177: 	var err error
178: 	if configFile != "" {
179: 		if configFile == "-" {
180: 			config, err = io.ReadAll(os.Stdin)
181: 			if err != nil {
182: 				return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("reading config from stdin: %v", err)
183: 			}
184: 			logger.Info("using config from stdin")
185: 		} else {
186: 			config, err = os.ReadFile(configFile)
187: 			if err != nil {
188: 				return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("reading config from file: %v", err)
189: 			}
190: 			logger.Info("using config from file", zap.String("file", configFile))
191: 		}
192: 	} else if adapterName == "" {
193: 		// if the Caddyfile adapter is plugged in, we can try using an
194: 		// adjacent Caddyfile by default
195: 		cfgAdapter = caddyconfig.GetAdapter("caddyfile")
196: 		if cfgAdapter != nil {
197: 			config, err = os.ReadFile("Caddyfile")
198: 			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
199: 				// okay, no default Caddyfile; pretend like this never happened
200: 				cfgAdapter = nil
201: 			} else if err != nil {
202: 				// default Caddyfile exists, but error reading it
203: 				return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("reading default Caddyfile: %v", err)
204: 			} else {
205: 				// success reading default Caddyfile
206: 				configFile = "Caddyfile"
207: 				logger.Info("using adjacent Caddyfile")
208: 			}
209: 		}
210: 	}
211: 
212: 	if yes, err := isCaddyfile(configFile, adapterName); yes {
213: 		adapterName = "caddyfile"
214: 	} else if err != nil {
215: 		return nil, "", err
216: 	}
217: 
218: 	// load config adapter
219: 	if adapterName != "" {
220: 		cfgAdapter = caddyconfig.GetAdapter(adapterName)
221: 		if cfgAdapter == nil {
222: 			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("unrecognized config adapter: %s", adapterName)
223: 		}
224: 	}
225: 
226: 	// adapt config
227: 	if cfgAdapter != nil {
228: 		adaptedConfig, warnings, err := cfgAdapter.Adapt(config, map[string]any{
229: 			"filename": configFile,
230: 		})
231: 		if err != nil {
232: 			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("adapting config using %s: %v", adapterName, err)
233: 		}
234: 		logger.Info("adapted config to JSON", zap.String("adapter", adapterName))
235: 		for _, warn := range warnings {
236: 			msg := warn.Message
237: 			if warn.Directive != "" {
238: 				msg = fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s", warn.Directive, warn.Message)
239: 			}
240: 			logger.Warn(msg,
241: 				zap.String("adapter", adapterName),
242: 				zap.String("file", warn.File),
243: 				zap.Int("line", warn.Line))
244: 		}
245: 		config = adaptedConfig
246: 	} else if len(config) != 0 {
247: 		// validate that the config is at least valid JSON
248: 		err = json.Unmarshal(config, new(any))
249: 		if err != nil {
250: 			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("config is not valid JSON: %v; did you mean to use a config adapter (the --adapter flag)?", err)
251: 		}
252: 	}
253: 
254: 	return config, configFile, nil
255: }
